questions.stem: How can FSH be used to help treat infertility?

options.text: It prevents ovulation so the uterus can heal
It makes the uterus lining thicker so embryos implant more easily
It increases progesterone levels to maintain pregnancy
It is given to stimulate egg maturation in women who do not produce enough FSH naturally

questions.explanation: FSH can be given as a fertility drug to women who do not produce enough of it naturally. It stimulates follicle development and egg maturation in the ovaries, increasing the chance of ovulation.
